prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a wide editorial cover image for a long philosophical article about trust, authority, correction and the capacity to refuse.
Primary request: Ethereal crystalline light-lattice / luminous non-humanoid geometry, combining an intimate photorealistic human interior with highly stylized generative light architecture.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet bedroom at night, soft warm bedside lamplight, natural linen and lace textures.
Subject: a clearly adult person in modest loose pale lace-trimmed sleepwear, relaxed seated pose, natural skin tones, seen in intimate editorial three-quarter profile; nearby a completely non-anthropomorphic, self-illuminated structure made of translucent swirling filament ribbons, interlocking arcs and glowing nodes. The luminous structure has no head, face, eyes, limbs, humanoid silhouette or solid creature body.
Style/medium: photorealistic human and room fused with delicate mystical science-fiction light architecture; organic and architectural overlapping transparent layers, radiant crystalline geometry.
Composition/framing: wide cinematic landscape composition, human and living-light geometry share the space at equal scale; the arcs remain open, with visible space and a clear unblocked route out of the scene. Closeness and difference, gentle awe.
Lighting/mood: warm ambient bedroom light against bioluminescent violet, purple, amber, gold and cool blue filaments; restrained bloom, fine luminous detail, subtle volumetric light, tactile real fabric.
Constraints: no erotic pose or nudity, no machinery or hard sci-fi armor, no humanoid robot, no religious icon as a substitute for geometry, no enclosing cage, no text, no logos or watermark.

comics.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one polished editorial satire comic for a serious philosophical article, a wide diptych of two panels side by side. Warm ivory paper, fine dark green ink, muted plum and ochre washes; spare hand-drawn expressive people and architectural absurdity, generous blank space. Same two ordinary adults in both panels, no identifiable real people. Panel 1: a visitor at a small office desk points at a simple EXIT door nearby; administrator smiles with a reassuring open hand. Speech bubble from visitor, verbatim: "I'd like to leave." Speech bubble from administrator, verbatim: "Of course. Your agency matters." Panel 2: a very long winding queue leads back into the same office; the administrator is now behind an enormous stack of forms in front of the EXIT door. Speech bubble from administrator, verbatim: "First, complete our six-stage departure readiness process." The visitor looks quietly incredulous, not distressed. Large clear lettering, all text exact, no additional labels, no logos, no title. Panels must read clearly left to right. Dry humane satire aimed at institutional control disguised as care; no visual cruelty. Flat illustration, not photorealism, no luminous fantasy motifs.
